title: An import update with a blank term cell keeps the stored term
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create customer A for this test, on Net 45.
  • Have a contacts import file that updates customer A (same customer) with a new phone number and an empty credit term cell.
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through Settings, Data Import, Contacts.
  2. Open customer A's customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The import finishes.
  • No row is refused because of its credit term.

Step 2:

  • The phone number is updated and the "Credit term" still reads Net 45.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
